title: Top 15 Streamline Integrations for Vacation Rental Property Managers
summary: What the top Streamline VRS integrations do and how each connects, from PriceLabs and Breezeway to smart locks, screening and work orders.
body_markdown:
Updated November 2026


Your reservations, owners and units all live in Streamline. Much of the work around each stay doesn't. A cleaner checks in from the field. A guest needs a door code at 11 p.m. A technician buys a part with a company card, and the receipt ends up in a truck console.


Without a connection to Streamline, each of those hand-offs turns into copy-and-paste work for your team.


Streamline integrations take that step away. Streamline's Self-Service Onboarding gives each partner a token key and secret, so the tools below read and write Streamline data without custom development. Every one of them has a documented Streamline integration.


These 15 made the list because professional vacation rental managers use them widely and each one owns a core job. The numbers set a reading order, not a ranking. Each is a strong pick, and they fit together well.


## Finance and Data


Owner money has to land in the right place, and you need a clear read on how your properties perform against the market.


### 1. Topkey


Topkey is the AI-powered financial operating system built specifically for vacation rental managers. Integrating directly into Streamline and your accounting software, Topkey provides a single, unified system that automates expenses, bookkeeping, receipts, banking, corporate cards, AP/bill pay, inventory, and revenue reconciliation, so you can get back to what matters: hospitality. For Streamline users, it's how card charges and receipts become work orders and owner charges, coded to the right unit and owner. It's listed in Streamline's Integration Marketplace.


How it works with Streamline.


Topkey syncs with Streamline and your accounting software, so purchases, bills and owner charges end up where your owner statements live:


- Work orders and owner charges.


Card charges and expenses become Streamline work orders or owner charges, with the receipt, vendor, property and markup rules carried over. Supplies checked out from inventory are tied to the right owner the same way.


- Multi-property purchases.


One purchase that covers several properties can be split into a work order for each one.


- Property coding.


Topkey syncs your Streamline property list, so picking a property applies the right unit, owner and GL coding.


- Field work.


Completed Breezeway tasks come into Topkey with their property details, so the work gets billed.


Why it helps.


Every card swipe, bill and inventory checkout ends up on the right owner's statement in Streamline with the receipt attached. Month-end close goes from days to hours, your team saves at least 25 hours a month, and owner billables go up 15% to 20%.


[Visit Topkey](https://topkey.io/integrations/streamline)


### 2. Key Data


Key Data is a business intelligence platform for vacation rental managers. It turns your reservation, occupancy and revenue data into clean metrics and shows how your performance compares to the market. It's the exclusive data partner of the Vacation Rental Management Association (VRMA).


How it works with Streamline.


Key Data connects directly to Streamline and pulls in reservation, occupancy and revenue data automatically, so there are no exports or imports to manage.


Why it helps.


You can see how you're performing against your market without building reports by hand, which makes pricing decisions and owner conversations easier to back up.


[Visit Key Data](https://www.keydatadashboard.com/)


## Pricing and Revenue


Streamline has its own revenue management in RevMax. These two are popular outside options for managers who want their own pricing rules or a second view of the market.


### 3. PriceLabs


PriceLabs adjusts nightly rates and minimum stays every day based on demand in your market.


How it works with Streamline.


PriceLabs sends daily rates and minimum stay requirements to your Streamline listings up to 720 days ahead. Once length-of-stay pricing is enabled in Streamline, PriceLabs can manage that too. You connect it with a Streamline token key and secret.


Why it helps.


Your rates stay current almost two years out without anyone touching the rate grid. That's a big help if guests book far in advance.


[Visit PriceLabs](https://hello.pricelabs.co/)


### 4. Wheelhouse


Wheelhouse is a revenue management platform that recommends nightly prices and minimum stays from its own market data.


How it works with Streamline.


You connect Wheelhouse with a Streamline token key and secret, and it imports each unit's name and Streamline property ID. Once you turn on sync, Wheelhouse updates prices and minimum stays in Streamline every day. It can also deliver length-of-stay pricing through a Streamline LOS map.


Why it helps.


You can test outside pricing on a few units before changing your whole portfolio, so there's little risk in trying it.


[Visit Wheelhouse](https://www.usewheelhouse.com/)


## Operations and Housekeeping


These two make sure every turnover gets cleaned and checked.


### 5. Breezeway


Breezeway is a field operations app that schedules cleans, inspections and repairs, then confirms the work with photos.


How it works with Streamline.


Breezeway connects to Streamline for reservations, calendars and task scheduling, so jobs are built around real stays.


Why it helps.


You can see every clean and inspection got done before the next guest arrives, even across a large team and many units.


[Visit Breezeway](https://www.breezeway.io/)


### 6. Turno


Turno schedules your cleaners automatically and gives you a marketplace of local cleaners for backup.


How it works with Streamline.


Turno's direct Streamline integration brings your reservations into Turno, so cleanings are scheduled around each checkout.


Why it helps.


Every checkout gets a cleaning on the calendar, and finding a replacement is easy when someone cancels. That's a lifesaver in markets where you don't have your own cleaners.


[Visit Turno](https://turno.com/)


## Access and Smart Home


These two control who gets through the door.


### 7. PointCentral


PointCentral is a smart property platform that manages locks, thermostats and other devices across thousands of vacation rentals from one place.


How it works with Streamline.


PointCentral creates access codes from your reservations. Guests get their code before check-in, and access ends at checkout.


Why it helps.


Guests get in without a key and lose access at checkout, and you can keep an eye on thermostats and other devices between stays.


[Visit PointCentral](https://www.pointcentral.com/)


### 8. RemoteLock


RemoteLock is one access platform for many lock brands, so different properties don't need different apps.


How it works with Streamline.


RemoteLock has been a Streamline partner for more than a decade. When a booking comes in, Streamline passes the details to RemoteLock, which creates the access code and sets it to the check-in and check-out times automatically. Vendors can get their own codes, and access logs show who came and went.


Why it helps.


Guest and vendor codes run on their own, with a record of every entry. It shines when nearly every property in your portfolio has a different lock.


[Visit RemoteLock](https://remotelock.com/)


## Guest Experience


These four shape how guests check in, find information and get answers.


### 9. Enso Connect


Enso Connect gives guests a branded web app for check-in, messages and paid extras, powered by AI.


How it works with Streamline.


Enso imports your Streamline listings and reservations, then runs AI guest messaging, digital check-in and upsells from that data.


Why it helps.


Guests get a smoother arrival and easy ways to add to their stay, and your team answers fewer routine questions. You get a branded guest app without building one.


[Visit Enso Connect](https://ensoconnect.com/integrations/streamline)


### 10. Touch Stay


Touch Stay turns your property details into digital guidebooks, with a unique guide link for each reservation.


How it works with Streamline.


Touch Stay imports your Streamline properties and maps property fields, such as the Wi-Fi name and password, into each guide. That data syncs every 24 hours. Touch Stay also syncs confirmed reservations and sends a unique guide link back to Streamline for your guest messages.


Why it helps.


Guests get the right door code and Wi-Fi details in the messages you already send, so they don't have to call. Update a detail once and every guide stays current.


[Visit Touch Stay](https://touchstay.com/integrations/streamline)


### 11. Operto


Operto offers guest experience, smart device and team tools for vacation rentals.


How it works with Streamline.


Operto Teams imports bookings, properties and guest names, phone numbers and emails from Streamline.


Why it helps.


Staff schedules stay in step with real bookings, so nobody works from an outdated list. It suits teams that want scheduling, guest tools and smart devices from one provider.


[Visit Operto](https://operto.com/)


### 12. Besty


Besty is an AI platform for short-term rental managers that handles guest messaging and upsells.


How it works with Streamline.


Besty uses Streamline as the source of your reservation and listing data, and its team sets up the Streamline connection with you during onboarding. From there it answers guest messages, follows up on inquiries and offers upsells like gap nights and early check-in.


Why it helps.


Inquiries get a fast reply and open nights get offered automatically, so you turn more inquiries into bookings.


[Visit Besty](https://www.getbesty.ai/)


## Screening and Protection


This group screens guests before they arrive and puts coverage behind each stay.


### 13. Autohost


Autohost is an AI guest screening platform for short-term rentals.


How it works with Streamline.


You activate Autohost through Streamline's Self-Service Onboarding. It screens and verifies incoming reservations automatically and writes a verification status back to the reservation in Streamline.


Why it helps.


Your team sees which guests are cleared right on the reservation in Streamline, without vetting each one by hand.


[Visit Autohost](https://www.autohost.ai/)


### 14. Safely


Safely provides guest screening and short-term rental insurance.


How it works with Streamline.


Safely lists Streamline among its integrations, so reservations flow into Safely automatically. Screening starts at booking, coverage attaches to each stay, and your team doesn't have to send reservation reports.


Why it helps.


Each stay is screened and insured without chasing large security deposits.


[Visit Safely](https://safely.com/)


### 15. Rental Guardian


Rental Guardian is an insurance technology platform for vacation rentals.


How it works with Streamline.


Rental Guardian powers Streamline Insurance, Streamline's built-in travel and property protection program. It works with your Streamline reservations and flows into Streamline accounting.


Why it helps.


Guests can protect their trip at checkout, which also adds a revenue line for your company. Because it's built into Streamline, it flows straight into your accounting.


[Visit Rental Guardian](https://www.rentalguardian.com/)


## How These Integrations Fit Together


On a busy Saturday, Autohost clears every arriving guest. PointCentral sends each one a code that works only for their dates. Touch Stay delivers the guide with the right Wi-Fi password. Breezeway runs the turnovers. And when a technician replaces a thermostat at one home and buys filters for three others, Topkey turns those purchases into marked-up work orders in Streamline, each on the right owner's statement with the receipt attached.


The technician never fills out an expense report, and the bookkeeper never chases a receipt.


You'll find most of these partners in Streamline's Integration Marketplace, and most connect through Self-Service Onboarding.


## Streamline Integrations FAQ


### What is the Streamline Integration Marketplace?


It's Streamline's directory of partner tools, grouped by category such as pricing, operations, locks, guest experience, insurance, payments and accounting. Partners connect to Streamline through its API.


### How do Streamline integrations connect?


In Streamline, go to Main Menu, then Third Party Integrations, then Self-Service Onboarding. Enable the partner to get a token key and secret, then enter them in the partner's app.


### Does Streamline integrate with PriceLabs?


Yes. PriceLabs sends daily rates and minimum stays to Streamline listings up to 720 days ahead, and it can manage length-of-stay pricing once that's enabled in Streamline.


### How do I get expenses onto Streamline owner statements?


Expenses reach owner statements as work orders or owner charges in Streamline. Expense tools like Topkey create both from card and bank transactions, with receipts and markups included.


### What smart locks work with Streamline?


PointCentral and RemoteLock are two long-standing options in Streamline's marketplace, which lists several more.


### Do I need a separate guest screening tool with Streamline?


Streamline lists screening partners in its marketplace for this. Autohost and Safely both screen Streamline reservations before guests arrive.
